root_cause.text: In xe_gem_prime_import(), when dma_buf_dynamic_attach() succeeds but subsequent xe_dma_buf_init_obj() fails, the code returns the error without calling dma_buf_detach(), leaking the attachment.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `dma_buf_detach(dma_buf, attach);` before the error return when `xe_dma_buf_init_obj()` fails, as shown in the diff: `if (IS_ERR(obj)) { dma_buf_detach(dma_buf, attach); return obj; }`. The CVE description states "the attachment from dma_buf_dynamic_attach() is not detached" in this error path.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix resource leak by detaching dma_buf on error from xe_dma_buf_init_obj() and clarify ownership in comment.
intent_record.what: Expanded comment to clarify that xe_dma_buf_init_obj() takes ownership of bo on both success and failure, and added dma_buf_detach() call on error path before returning.
intent_record.how: On failure of xe_dma_buf_init_obj(), the function now calls dma_buf_detach(dma_buf, attach) to properly clean up the attachment, preventing a resource leak. The comment update makes ownership semantics explicit so the caller does not touch bo after the call.

candidates.rationale: This early return after xe_dma_buf_init_obj() fails bypasses dma_buf_detach(), causing a resource leak of the dma_buf attachment.
